objective_value: <float> Total annual system cost represented by the complete submitted witness.
model_variables: <dict, key: canonical variable name> Sparse complete witness; omitted variables are zero. Use underscore-separated names exactly as specified by model_variable_name_patterns, not descriptive aliases.

investment_decisions.generator_id: <int> Identifier of the generator cluster this entry refers to.
investment_decisions.resource_type: <str> Technology label of the generator cluster (e.g. onshore_wind, ng_cc, battery_4hr, hydro).
investment_decisions.zone: <int> Zone in which the generator cluster is located.
investment_decisions.y_P_new: <float> Number of new power-capacity units built for this generator cluster, in whole-unit increments of its capacity size.
investment_decisions.y_P_ret: <float> Number of existing power-capacity units retired for this generator cluster, in whole-unit increments of its capacity size.
investment_decisions.y_P_total_MW: <float> Total installed power capacity of this generator cluster in MW after additions and retirements.
investment_decisions.y_E_new: <float, storage only> Number of new energy-capacity units built for this storage cluster, in whole-unit increments of its energy capacity size.
investment_decisions.y_E_ret: <float, storage only> Number of existing energy-capacity units retired for this storage cluster, in whole-unit increments of its energy capacity size.
investment_decisions.y_E_total_MWh: <float, storage only> Total installed energy storage capacity of this storage cluster in MWh after additions and retirements.

transmission_decisions.line_id: <int> Identifier of the transmission line this entry refers to.
transmission_decisions.y_F_new_MW: <float> New transmission capacity added to this line in MW.
transmission_decisions.total_capacity_MW: <float> Total line capacity in MW equal to existing capacity plus new capacity.
